From: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@meddata.com>

Cc: security-ops@meddata.com
Date: Sun, 13 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG artifacts needed to close procurement

Hi Sofia,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team at MedData is excited about the potential. Procurement is asking us to close out a SIG assessment before legal will sign the SOW. Could you send the final artifacts we need to attach to the SIG (we'll mark items as provided/redacted):

- SOC 2 report (we only need the most recent attestation, redacted ok)
- Pen test summary (executive summary is fine; we can request more if needed)
- ISO statements (ISO27001/ISO27701 coverage statement)
- Security overview slide deck for stakeholders (pptx)

If possible, we'd like the bundle by EOD tomorrow (Mon). Also let me know if any items require an NDA or access controls on your side — procurement may want a DocuSign statement for scope items.

Best,
Alicia Gomez
Sr. IT Risk Manager, MedData Inc.
Alicia.Gomez@meddata.com

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 13 Jun 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: SIG artifacts needed to close procurement

Marissa / Rishi — forwarding request from MedData. Quick plan:

- SOC2: 2025 Type II attestation PDF exists but must be redacted for customer PII. Marissa can sanitize and drop into Drive.
- Pen test: vendor summary (we have an executive summary redacted) — need permission from PenTest Labs to share full report; the exec summary is safe. Rishi please confirm.
- ISO statements: we have a standard ISO27001/27701 coverage statement (static PDF) ready.
- Security deck: latest v2 pptx; I'll attach a sanitized copy.

Timeline: Marissa — SOC2 redaction + Drive upload by Mon 12:00pm. Rishi — confirm pen test summary share and add one-line encryption/KMS note for Alicia. I'll assemble and respond to Alicia by 3pm Mon.

If legal needs a signing artifact, we can push the ISO statement through DocuSign (link below) — is that okay?

Thanks,
Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Head of Security Programs
Redwood Inference

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>

Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG artifacts needed to close procurement

Hi Alicia,

Attached are the artifacts requested for the SIG packet. We've redacted items that contain operational details or customer data. If you need unredacted evidence, we can arrange controlled access under an NDA.

Attachments included (redacted where noted):
- SOC2_Report_Redwood_2025_Redacted.pdf (Type II attestation, redactions applied to operational details)
- PenTest_Summary_2026_Redacted.pdf (executive summary; full report available under NDA/vendor agreement)
- ISO27001_Statement.pdf (ISO coverage and scope statement)
- Security_Program_Deck_v2.pptx (stakeholder-facing overview)

Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcdExample
DocuSign (ISO statement) if procurement needs a signed scope: https://www.docusign.com/iso-sign/ABCDEF123456
HubSpot case: 1234567

A couple of clarifications up front:
- The SOC 2 report is an attestation from our auditor; it does not include raw logs.
- The PenTest summary is vendor-provided executive findings and remediation status; pen test vendor contact is included below if you require direct validation.

Next steps per our side: Marissa sanitized the SOC2 PDF and uploaded to the Drive folder; Rishi added a short encryption/KMS note below (copied). If you confirm receipt and procurement is OK with the redacted docs, we can route the ISO statement through DocuSign for signature.

Encryption/KMS note (from Rishi): AES-256 encryption at rest for customer data in our datastore; keys managed via a FIPS 140-2 compliant KMS with HSM-backed key wrapping. We rotate master keys annually and apply per-tenant key separation for Dedicated customers.

If you'd like a short call with our pen test vendor to walk through findings, we can coordinate — suggested contact: reports@pentestlabs.com.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Head of Security Programs
Redwood Inference

Attachments (as referenced): SOC2_Report_Redwood_2025_Redacted.pdf; PenTest_Summary_2026_Redacted.pdf; ISO27001_Statement.pdf; Security_Program_Deck_v2.pptx

Sofia — thanks, this is very helpful and on our timeline. Quick follow-ups:

1) For procurement: they want a named contact and title from Redwood for an escalations sign-off. Who should I list?
2) Do you have a one-paragraph statement we can paste into our SIG response about data retention and log access windows?
3) We'll likely want a 30-minute call with PenTest Labs to validate a single medium finding — can you introduce us to the vendor contact?

If those are quick to provide we can mark the packet as complete and move the SOW to legal.

Thanks,
Alicia

Hi Alicia — copying the pen test vendor and Sofia for context. Quick answers below: 

1) Escalation contact for procurement: Sofia Ivanova, Head of Security Programs, Redwood Inference — sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai, +1 (415) 555-0172.

2) Data retention / logs statement (one paragraph you can paste): "Redwood Inference retains system logs and operational telemetry for a default period of 90 days. Customer application data retention is configurable per contract; default retention for customer-managed data is 365 days. Access to raw logs is restricted to authorized security and SRE personnel and is provided to customers or auditors under contract or written request as part of compliance verifications."

3) Pen test vendor contact: PenTest Labs <reports@pentestlabs.com>. I've looped them in — please propose a 30-minute window and they'll confirm availability.

If you need us to route the ISO statement via DocuSign to procurement, reply-all and we'll kick that off.

Regards,
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Platform Security
Redwood Inference
